run.binary_rule: dedicated outcome judgment per call (temperature 0, JSON, evidence-cited); label in {success,fail}; same question the blind annotator answered. NOT derived from the 5 semantic dims; kappa calibrates THIS judgment only — the semantic dims remain uncalibrated diagnostics.

dims.name: language_match
dims.reason: The agent successfully processed the user's code-switched input containing Hindi script and English, maintaining a consistent and appropriate language flow throughout the interaction.

dims.name: faithfulness
dims.reason: The agent accurately captured the location, date, and time provided by the user without introducing any external or hallucinated information.

dims.name: repair_quality
dims.reason: The agent successfully parsed the partial location information provided in turn 6 and asked a targeted follow-up for the missing date and time in turn 7.

dims.name: conciseness
dims.reason: The agent provides necessary information without unnecessary filler or repetitive phrasing throughout the interaction.

dims.name: user_frustration
dims.reason: The user provided information clearly and the agent successfully processed the request without any repair loops or signs of irritation.

binary.label: success
binary.reason: The agent successfully captured the location, date, and time provided by the user and confirmed the appointment booking.
